newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon cautious on Intel.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon cautious on Intel.

text.p: Salomon Brothers analyst Erika Klauer said she is concerned Intel Corp's second quarter earnings may fall short of expectations and she is considering reducing her third quarter earnings estimate on the company.
In a research note provided by Salomon, Klauer said Intel's revenues, gross margins and earnings were all cause for caution in the second quarter.

"We expect revenues will come in toward the low end of the revised guidance," Klauer said in the note. "We believe gross margins should be in the 60-61 percent range compared to 64.2 percent in the first quarter."
"As a result, this could cause the company to miss our estimate of $1.86 as well as disappoint street expectations of $1.82 per share," she said.
Klauer also said Intel's guidance for the third quarter after it reports second quarter results on July 15 could be even more important for the stock performance than Intel's second quarter results.
Regarding the third quarter, she said she expected Intel's sales would likely be flat due to declining average selling prices and depreciation expenses which would begin to ramp up.
Other expenses, including research and development and selling, general and administrative should grow at least five percent, she said, due to Pentium II related spending.
"In conclusion," she said, "we would anticipate that we will lower our third quarter earnings estimate following the conference call."
Third quarter earnings, she said, could come in "below the second quarter in the $1.70 to $1.75 range".
Klauer maintained a hold rating on the shares.
Intel shares fell 2-3/4 to 149-7/8 on volume of about six million shares, the second most active stock on Nasdaq in late morning.
